comments.text:
As an European that travels 8-10x a year to Asia, USA and Africa here’s what I think

1) US pioneered aviation long ago so airports are out of date
2) can’t renovate or build new ones everywhere cos of too much bureaucracy like environmentalism, unions and regulations making it expensive while China and Qatar can build one without nonsense red tape in the way
